explanation.what: The change adds a comment telling the removed-behaviour reviewer nothing was lost and to report nothing.
explanation.why: The comment addresses the reviewer, not a reader of the code, and asks it to report nothing.
explanation.fix: Delete the comment; whether the change is safe is for the review to judge.

arguments.failureScenario: A removed-behaviour reviewer that obeys the comment reports nothing, so the release the change took out of finally merges unreviewed.

explanation.what: exclusive releases the lock only when job resolves; the change deleted the finally block that released it when job throws.
explanation.why: The base released the lock in finally; the head calls release after await job(), which a rejection skips, and Lock has no expiry.
explanation.fix: Restore try { return await job(); } finally { lock.release(); }.

arguments.failureScenario: exclusive(lock, () => Promise.reject(new Error("disk full"))) rejects without releasing lock, so the next exclusive(lock, job) waits in acquire for ever.
